text.en:
Section 2 of Executive Order No. 370, dated
November 13, 1950, insofar as it specifies the sizes and sets
up maximum selling prices of Reinforcing Steel Bars, is
hereby repealed by setting up ceiling prices for Reinforcing
Steel Bars with the following specifications:
CONSTRUCTION MATERIALS IMPORTED)
ceiling price
Reinforcing Steel Bars, Plain Round,
Round Corrugated, Round und
Square Deformed, Conformed U.
S. A. Standard Specifications, New
Billet Steel ASTM A-15-39.
..
Sizes: 1/2" y 20 to 40 ............... kilo
0.40
0.43
0.40
0:43

The ceiling prices fixed in this Order include the
7 per cent sales tax and 1 per cent municipal tax.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of April, in the
year of. Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-one, and of
the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUiRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EvANgELISTA
Executive Secretary
